enable_on_boot.docs:
**boolean**: Bring the BLE stack up during boot. Defaults to `false`: on the single-core LN882H, stack init during boot competes with the WiFi connection handshake, so consumers enable the stack lazily on first use instead.

*See also: [LN882H Bluetooth Low Energy](https://esphome.io/components/ln882h_ble#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used to reference this component.

*See also: [LN882H Bluetooth Low Energy](https://esphome.io/components/ln882h_ble#configuration-variables)*
